warrant: This check grades the numerical quantities named in output-contract.json on the independently materialized official operands. skimage.segmentation.slic (code/scikit-image/src/skimage/segmentation/slic_superpixels.py:105): fixed image operands and segmentation parameters determine physical region membership; component labels are arbitrary names, while the region partition and background are the graded quantities; skimage.color.label2rgb (code/scikit-image/src/skimage/color/colorlabel.py:85): the pinned color convention fixes channel order, matrix coefficients, offsets and nonlinear gamma or polar conversions; arithmetic reassociation can change rounding but a channel swap or resolved gain error changes the measured color; skimage.filters.sobel (code/scikit-image/src/skimage/filters/edges.py:199): the pinned stencil, boundary mode, scale and normalization define the filtered pixel field; convolution or spectral arithmetic can change final rounding but changing the spatial operator changes resolved intensities. The named precision bounds retain exact discrete results and allow small floating rounding changes; a resolved one-percent gain error, a changed integer count or a changed physical region is not treated as numerical noise. The perturbation reaches only materialized call 1 (skimage.filters.sobel); its CLI-recorded spread is sensitivity evidence for that workload, not a floor for every other call. No alternative-build or accelerator floor is claimed. The source-linked bounds remain proposals until the human reviews the measured calibration and accepts their scientific scope.
